profile.headline: Software Engineer | Backend, Tools & Automation, Reliability | Driving High-Impact, Maintainable Platforms
profile.summary:
I bring deep expertise in full-stack architecture and scalable backend systems, along with strong experience in developer tooling, CI/CD automation, and microservices design. My background in software quality and reliability engineering, combined with test automation and framework development, allows me to deliver high-performance, maintainable systems. 

I excel at mentoring and leading teams, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and driving strategic technical initiatives that align with business goals. Additionally, I am skilled in performance optimization, system resilience, and translating complex technical challenges into actionable solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Built and scaled backend systems and microservices for a life insurance platform, enabling agents with reliable, high-performance tools. Led architecture design for document services, reducing latency by 40% and improving system resilience. Developed scalable backend services using Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, optimized RESTful APIs, and implemented exponential back-off and retry mechanisms, cutting customer-reported issues by 10% and boosting uptime. Served as the SME for document storage, ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient solutions across teams, while mentoring peers and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Life Insurance · SQL · Gitlab · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · Git · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Technical Team Lead – Engineering Tools & Automation
positions.description: Designed and developed developer-facing test frameworks for a life insurance platform, empowering engineering teams to independently validate features and maintain high system quality while reducing reliance on manual testing. Championed automation strategies integrated into CI/CD pipelines, improving feedback speed and code reliability. Actively contributed to architecture and technology decisions to ensure scalable, maintainable testing solutions. Mentored and coached a team of SDETs, created onboarding materials and best practice guides, and migrated automated tests from Protractor to Cypress, increasing test stability by 30% and accelerating release cycles.
